title: Promotion vs. Job-Hop Calculator
description: Compare staying for an internal promotion against an external job-hop over a 5-year horizon, netting out forfeited equity, ramp risk, tenure reset, and benefits gap to find the true break-even external premium.
data_vintage: 2026 — BLS OEWS 2025 labeled heuristic; user-input figures govern
regulatory_citations: BLS OEWS 2025 (wage growth heuristics — labeled, user-overridable)

mcp_tool_definition.name: promotion_vs_job_hop
mcp_tool_definition.description: Compare 5-year cumulative compensation for staying (internal promotion) vs. leaving (external job-hop), netting forfeited equity, ramp cost, and benefits gap. Returns winner, net advantage, and break-even external premium.

hopPremiumPct.description: External offer premium over current base (%), default ~15

rampMonths.description: Months to full effectiveness in new role (default 3)

tenureResetPct.description: Annual cost of tenure/PTO reset as % of salary (default 3)
